working_definition: Author cell type 'adult ventral nervous system' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult body and body wall, 10322 cells): neurons of the ventral nerve cord. Authors' term FBbt:00004052 adult ventral nerve cord is a region; authors' broad class is neuron.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any neuron that has its soma located in some adult ventral nerve cord cell body rind.

justification: The authors' term is a region; the cells are its neurons (broad class neuron), and FBbt has adult VNC neuron as the cell-level equivalent.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: The region of the adult central nervous system posterior to the brain, containing all thoracic and abdominal neuromeres.
